description: Still-deployable historical disk-offload Candidate using the exact official native LTX 1.4.1 pipeline with the LTX-2.3 distilled 1.1 checkpoint/upscaler pair and Gemma 3 companion closure. The 93 GB startup and 77 GB steady declarations conservatively retain the previously reviewed 31 GB disk-versus-CPU offload advantage, 8 GB growth, and 8 GB system reserve; the upstream decode-tiling OOM fix is not used to lower admission bounds without a physical canary. Physical Spark acceptance remains pending. LTX-2.5 BF16 is the current fidelity baseline and LTX-2.5 FP8-cast is the current lower-memory canary; this immutable execution contract remains available for reproducibility.
title: LTX-2.3 22B distilled 1.1 native synchronized single Spark (superseded)
